assessment: This important work presents two studies on predictive processing in subjects with and without tinnitus, matched for age, sex and hearing loss. These studies together provide compelling evidence for an enhanced predictability of upcoming sounds in regular sequences in EEG data recorded from tinnitus subjects. This work will be of interest to researchers, especially neuroscientists, in the tinnitus field and beyond.
